## Corrected Visualization

This visualization examines mean BMI across NHANES cycles by income group.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

nhanes <- read_csv(
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

bmi_summary <- nhanes |>
  filter(!is.na(BMI), !is.na(IncomeGroup), !is.na(Cycle)) |>
  group_by(Cycle, IncomeGroup) |>
  summarise(
    mean_bmi = mean(BMI),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

corrected_plot <- ggplot(
  bmi_summary,
  aes(x = Cycle, y = mean_bmi,
      color = IncomeGroup, group = IncomeGroup)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean BMI by Income Group Across NHANES Cycles",
    subtitle = "Descriptive comparison of BMI across income groups",
    x = "NHANES cycle",
    y = "Mean BMI (kg/m²)",
    color = "Income group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(corrected_plot)

ggsave(
  "corrected-plot.png",
  corrected_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
